note: MEASURED test counts per core directory, used as FLOORS by tools/run-core-tests.mjs. A directory recorded here that stops being discovered, or that runs fewer tests than this, fails the gate loudly — a number that drops is a failure even when every test passes. Rewrite only with `node tools/run-core-tests.mjs --update-floors`, on a green tree, as a deliberate single act: this file must never be edited by parallel workers, because a concurrent read-modify-write on a shared list is the exact defect the discovering gate was built to end.
